play.where: Player bar along the bottom, and the play button on a file row (All music, later Review).

pause.where: Player bar along the bottom, and the play button on the file that is playing.

playNamed.purpose: Screen-reader name of a row's play button; the file's name is data.
playNamed.where: Play button on a file row (screen-reader label).

pauseNamed.purpose: Screen-reader name of a row's play button while that file plays.
pauseNamed.where: Play button on the file that is playing (screen-reader label).

position.purpose: Screen-reader name of the scrub bar.
position.where: Player bar along the bottom (screen-reader label).

refused.missing.purpose: Says why a file isn't played: it isn't on disk.
refused.missing.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, when the file is gone.

refused.driveNotConnected.purpose: Says why a file isn't played: its drive is unplugged.
refused.driveNotConnected.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, when the file's drive isn't connected.

refused.onlineOnly.purpose: Says why a file isn't played: it's a OneDrive file that isn't on this PC, and playing it would download it.
refused.onlineOnly.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, for an online-only OneDrive file.

refused.cantPlay.purpose: Says a file isn't played because it can't be read or decoded as audio.
refused.cantPlay.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, for a file the player can't use (unknown, unreadable or not decodable).
